title: Cardinal
metaDescription: 49 natural rubies, stone to stone in black rhodium — a continuous full-eternity bracelet of absolute red. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: The ruby has always commanded red. Not suggested it. Not approximated it. Cardinal answers that command in full. This is not a bracelet that asks for attention. It simply is. Forty-nine natural rubies, stone to stone, set in black rhodium. No gap between them. No interruption. Only the deepest red against the darkest ground — continuous, unbroken, from the first stone to the last.

specs.label: Stones
specs.body: 49 natural rubies · 10.08 carats total · 3.50mm per stone · continuous full-eternity setting. 12 round brilliant diamonds, pavé-set at the cross clasp.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Stone-to-stone throughout — no metal visible between rubies. Black rhodium finish over the entire bracelet. The cross clasp is pavé-set with 12 white diamonds.

specs.label: Finish
specs.body: High-polish black rhodium. The contrast between the red rubies and the black setting is absolute — nothing softened, nothing mediated.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private inquiry. Sizing and specification confirmed at time of order.
